nielsen.name: Match between system and real world

findings.title: 18 tap/click target(s) smaller than 24×24 px on /tmp/uxa-site/index.html
findings.detail: Small targets take longer to acquire and cause mis-taps, especially on touch.
findings.fix: Make targets at least 24×24 px (44×44 px for touch); add padding rather than enlarging icons.
findings.key: efficiency|# tap/click target(s) smaller than #×# px|/tmp/uxa-site/index.html

findings.title: Dead click on “Buy now”
findings.detail: 3 clicks produced no visible change (no DOM update, no navigation) within 1 s. The element is interactive, so feedback is missing or delayed.
findings.fix: Provide immediate visual feedback (active state, spinner, toast) for every action.

findings.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name (1 element) on /tmp/uxa-site/index.html
findings.detail: Ensure that elements labelled through their content must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
findings.fix: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name. See the rule guide for code examples.

evidence.text: Text inside the element is not included in the accessible name

findings.principle: Nielsen #1 Visibility of system status · Affordance
findings.title: Rage clicks on “Buy now”
findings.detail: User clicked 3 times in rapid succession on an interactive element (1 burst). This is a strong indicator the user expected something to happen and it didn't — or it was too slow.
findings.fix: Make the response immediate: show a pressed/loading state within 100 ms, disable while processing, and confirm completion.

findings.title: Navigation with 12 items on /tmp/uxa-site/index.html
findings.detail: Decision time grows with the number of choices. Long flat menus are hard to scan and remember.
findings.fix: Group into 5–9 top-level categories; move secondary items into sub-menus or a footer.

findings.title: 1 vague link label(s) like “click here” / “read more” on /tmp/uxa-site/index.html
findings.detail: Links should describe their destination out of context.
findings.fix: Rewrite link text to say where it goes (e.g. “Read the pricing guide”).
findings.key: consistency|# vague link label(s) like “click here” / “read more”|/tmp/uxa-site/index.html

findings.title: 13 links with href="#" or javascript: on /tmp/uxa-site/index.html
findings.detail: Links that are really buttons confuse assistive tech and break middle-click/new-tab.
findings.fix: Use <button> for actions and <a href> for navigation.
findings.key: consistency|# links with href="#" or javascript:|/tmp/uxa-site/index.html

findings.title: 1 console error(s)

findings.fix: Investigate console errors — they often signal broken features users silently hit.

findings.principle: Nielsen #5 & #9 — Error prevention; help users recover
findings.title: 1 asset(s) failed to load
findings.fix: Fix broken images/scripts/styles; missing assets degrade perceived quality.

findings.title: No ARIA live regions for status messages on /tmp/uxa-site/index.html
findings.detail: Success/error messages may not be announced to screen-reader users.
findings.fix: Announce async results via role="status" / role="alert".
findings.key: feedback|No ARIA live regions for status messages|/tmp/uxa-site/index.html

findings.title: 3 text element(s) below 12 px on /tmp/uxa-site/index.html
findings.detail: Very small text is hard to read, especially on mobile and for older users.
findings.fix: Use ≥ 16 px for body text and ≥ 12 px for captions.
